title: Owner authorizes a simple, clean and navigable redesign from the agreed role blueprint
summary: The owner asks to proceed with the agreed SIM-detail and renewal-control design, emphasizing simplicity, cleanliness, navigation and a modern interface. The next local preview will prioritize a shared SIM detail record, supplier funding and renewal work, manager promo planning, and explicit connected/unconnected/paused/unscheduled states. Existing DVendo visual foundations and the custom mark remain relevant; production deployment and live account or purchase actions are not part of this design authorization. Detailed numeric budget values and real provider renewal timing remain preview policy examples rather than verified operational parameters.

evidence.location: Owner proceed instruction for the redesign in this conversation
evidence.description: Proceed with a simple, clean, navigable and modern design.
